answer: One concrete defense: anchor each identity's weight to verifiable tenure. A public randomness beacon stamps every identity's first action, and influence accrues only along a trellis of time-separated, independently attested contributions. A sybil swarm minted in one burst shares a single horizon of origin, so the beacon exposes their synchrony and the trellis starves them of the spaced, independent history real contributors accumulate — faking a thousand aged, separately attested lineages costs far more than minting a thousand keys.
